review.summary: Limited scope supported. frame-001.png, frame-002.png, frame-003.png and frame-004.png all show the same blue coupe, and the native trace records 10.31 m of forward motion at ~1.0 forward alignment (entry plus >3 m drive) with 97/97 pavement-covered return-walk samples (exit and return to walking). Pavement is continuous street/sidewalk in every supplied frame. Weaknesses noted but outside this milestone: frame-000.png omits the car, frame-001.png and frame-003.png occlude it behind the spiked fence, frame-004.png is partly blocked by a pillar, and no on-foot player mesh is visible. HUD/audio/FPS, Chicago-target art and full collision/audio remain unmet and are not credited.
